Author: X-Fight Club
Name: XFC Fight Tracker
Description:
Runs X-Fight Club match types inside FFXIV: Basic Rules, Russian Roulette, Battle Royale, Gauntlet, Iron Crown, Tag Team, Power Bottom Extravaganza and more.

Tracks rolls read from chat, damage, eliminations, lives and brackets, and keeps a match history you can export.
Punchline: Track X-Fight Club fights, rolls and brackets in-game.
Changelog:
Initial prototype.

- All ten XFC match types with their real rules built in.
- Rolls read from the FFXIV chat log automatically.
- Damage, eliminations, lives and Iron Crown block scoring tracked.
- Match history with clipboard and CSV export.
